scope: One home visit. Replace one fence picket, straighten an existing gate as far as practicable, replace one toilet wax ring, and pick up one can of paint. Supply the paint and wax ring.

Carpentry portion of a larger renovation to an attached two-bedroom in-law dwelling. Replace two exterior entry doors with fiberglass composite, four interior doors and termite-damaged closet doors and trim. Pick up materials and dispose of removed doors and trim. Replace three deteriorated window ledges with plastic, then mud, sand and finish them. The customer worked alongside the handyman and did the general painting.
priced_line_descriptions: Doors and trim, materials and installation
Replace and finish deteriorated window ledges

scope: Open the existing galley kitchen to the living area in an apartment. The building handyman and superintendent, both licensed contractors, worked with the owners. Remove one non-load-bearing wall, then add cabinets, a counter-seating peninsula, countertop and overhead recessed lights. Existing cabinetry otherwise stays in place. The owners handled repainting and decorative updates separately.
priced_line_descriptions: New cabinetry, peninsula, countertop and overhead lights: materials
Install new cabinetry, peninsula, countertop and recessed lights

scope: Convert an unused kitchen laundry closet to a pantry. A handyman helps the owner build custom pine shelves for heavy food containers, with two 18-inch base cabinets with drawers and a beadboard back. The owner designed it. Include three work sessions, supply shopping and hauling. Base the materials on the quantities listed. The owner furnishes polyurethane, pulls and outlet cover. Exclude removable food containers and organizers.
priced_line_descriptions: Handyman labor including procurement and hauling

scope: In a small guest bathroom remodel, have a handyman paint after another trade's drywall repairs have dried. The homeowner supplies leftover paint. Have the same handyman return after the other trades to hang bathroom mirrors and hooks. Include the mirrors and hooks in the second visit. Exact quantities and sizes are unavailable.
priced_line_descriptions: Mirrors and hooks including purchase and mounting

scope: At a residence, pick up materials with the homeowner, install one exterior door and one interior door, cut the hinge mortises, replace the frames and install a dryer vent. The customer purchases materials and pays the handyman service for the work.
priced_line_descriptions: Two doors and other materials purchased by customer
Handyman labor including pickup, door installation and dryer vent

scope: In a residential hallway, relocate a ceiling light and smoke detector, and install and frame a new attic access panel. Include the trim, drywall, caulk and light, contractor procurement and any materials markup. The handyman company billed three and a half hours and credited an earlier consultation charge. The homeowner reports a store trip within the service visit.
priced_line_descriptions: All remaining net service and labor charges after credit
